title: Add Docker Hub push to CI post-merge pipeline
description: Add Docker Hub login and push steps to the CI workflow so that after a successful merge to master, the built image is pushed to Docker Hub as jonbaldie/beanstalkd:latest.

title: Improve Integration Tests
description: Enhance the Makefile 'test' target to actually start the beanstalkd container and verify it responds on port 11300, rather than just checking if the binary exists.
notes: Improved the test target in Makefile to actually start the Docker container, wait for port 11300 to become available using nc, and tear down the container afterwards. Added test.sh for this and integrated it.

title: Modernize Docker Build and Image Security
description: Update the Dockerfile to remove deprecated instructions (e.g., MAINTAINER), update base image practices, and ensure the service runs as a non-root user.
notes: Removed deprecated MAINTAINER, added `USER beanstalk` to run as a non-root user instead of root, and switched CMD to exec array format. Successfully built and tested the image.

title: Migrate CI from Travis to GitHub Actions
description: Travis CI is deprecated for this repo style. Create a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) to build the docker image and run tests. Remove .travis.yml.
notes: Migrated CI from Travis to GitHub Actions. Deleted .travis.yml and created .github/workflows/ci.yml which builds the docker image and runs make test.
